responsibility: This module provides GNU Modula-2 interface definitions for selected libiberty support services that gm2 code uses when acting like compiler driver or runtime support code. Its definition modules are thin foreign-function bindings that expose host-side utility routines such as temporary-file name creation and external program execution to Modula-2, letting gm2 components request unique temporary paths and launch subprocesses or command pipelines while handling C-style strings, status returns, and error reporting in a form usable from Modula-2. In GCC terms, this module sits in the language-support boundary between gm2 and shared compiler support libraries rather than implementing parsing, optimization, or code generation itself.
